title: Little-Tools
description: This resource pack reduces the size of some items, making them take up less screen space and easier to use. Perfect for fans of PvP and vanilla resource packs.
body: This resource pack reduces the size of some items such as swords, bows, crossbows, fishing rods, all tools, buckets, and other items. As a result, they take up less screen space and are more comfortable to use. It is perfect for fans of PvP and vanilla-style resource packs.
